title: On Citizen Click
description: Called when a Citizens NPC is clicked by a player.

title: Citizen Forcefield
description: Creates a forcefield around the NPCs with the specified width, height, strength and vertical strength.
syntax_pattern:
make %npcs% have %npcforcefield%
remove forcefield of %npcs%
remove %npcs%['s] forcefield

title: On Citizen Damage by Block
description:
Called when a Citizens NPC is damaged by a block.

title: On Citizen Despawn

title: On Citizen Left Click
description:
Called when a Citizens NPC is left clicked by a player.
Only is called if NPC is not vulnerable.

title: On Citizen Right Click
description: Called when a Citizens NPC is right clicked by a player

title: Citizen Is Paused
description: Whether the navigator of a Citizens NPC is paused.

title: Citizen Is Targetable
description: Make a Citizens NPC targetable by other mobs.
syntax_pattern:
(citizen|npc)[s] %npcs% (is|can be|are) target(able|ed)
(citizen|npc)[s] %npcs% (is(n't| not)|are(n't| not)|can('t|not be)) target(able|ed)

(citizen|npc)[s] %npcs% is owned by %player%

title: Citizen Mirror
description: Enable/Disable a Citizens NPC's Mirror Trait
syntax_pattern:
enable (npc|citizen)[s] %npcs% mirror [with name] [[and] with equipment]
disable (npc|citizen)[s] %npcs% mirror

title: Forcefield - Create
description: Expression to create a Citizens Forcefield. Default values are 1.
syntax_pattern: [a] forcefield [with width %number%[,| and]] [[with] height %number%[,| and]] [[with] strength %number%[,| and]] [[with] vertical strength %number%]

title: Hitbox With
description:
A Citizen Hitbox with the given components.
Scale is a multiplier for the hitbox. For example, if the width was 1 and the height was 2, then if the scale was 2, the hitbox's effective dimenstions would be 2 width and 4 height.
Default values are:
- Scale: 1
- Width: 1
- Height: 2
syntax_pattern: [a] hitbox [with scale %number%[,| and]] [[with] width %number%[,| and]] [[with] height %number%]
